comment: FAPI2-SP-FINAL-5.3.2.1-8 wants the issuer as the only client assertion audience; rustid also accepts the token, PAR and CIBA endpoint URLs and an audience array containing one of them, as FAPI 2 ID2 required, and checks issuer-only audiences when the assertion is typed client-authentication+jwt (RFC 7523bis) or strict_client_assertion_audience_validation is on, which needs that typ the suite doesn't send
